# Global Water Law Judicial Decisions Dataset

> A comparative dataset of 83,596 water law judicial decisions across Brazil, Canada, and
> the Netherlands (2016-2026), with scrapers, a jurimetric coding engine, and validation
> infrastructure, built to test the "Legal Last Mile" theory of administrative exclusion
> from sanitation access. Includes an agentified, AI-queryable version of the 2023 UNIARP
> master's thesis (Klaus Junior) that originated the project's Brazil-Ontario comparison,
> plus a dated, sourced record of which of that thesis's claims still hold today.

This is a research and open-data project by Claudio Antonio Klaus Junior, a dual-jurisdiction
lawyer (Brazil / Ontario) currently applying for a PhD in comparative sanitation law
(Brazil, Canada, Netherlands). The repository is public and citable; see CITATION.cff for
the formal citation and DOI.

## Core dataset

- [README](README.md): dataset scope, repository structure, scrapers, and preliminary findings ("The Legal Last Mile" theory).
- [Interactive dashboard](https://jrklaus8.github.io/water-law-dataset/): live visualization of the 83,596-decision dataset by country and governance category.
- [Preliminary research PDF](docs/The_Legal_Last_Mile_Research.pdf): the full write-up of the Legal Last Mile theory.
- [CITATION.cff](CITATION.cff): machine-readable citation metadata, including a reference to the originating 2023 thesis.
- [FUTURE_WORK.md](FUTURE_WORK.md): known gaps and open research questions for anyone extending the dataset.

## The agentified 2023 thesis

- [dissertation_agent/README.md](dissertation_agent/README.md): what this is, full citation
  metadata for the original thesis, an AI-assistance disclosure distinguishing the
  unchanged 2023 scholarly text from the 2026 AI-assisted conversion and research work,
  and why a law thesis was turned into an MCP-queryable agent at all.
- [dissertation_agent/USAGE.md](dissertation_agent/USAGE.md): how to run the MCP server and connect it to Claude Code or another MCP client; documents every exposed tool and resource.
- [dissertation_agent/direito-saneamento-sustentabilidade-paper/](dissertation_agent/direito-saneamento-sustentabilidade-paper/): the built, page-reviewed Paper2Skill package (full text, tables, figures) of the original thesis.
- [dissertation_agent/currency-notes.json](dissertation_agent/currency-notes.json): a dated,
  sourced check of whether specific statutes, a constitutional challenge, agency names, and
  statistics cited in the 2023 thesis still hold today, including one confirmed citation
  error and updated case-study data for all three Brazilian municipalities compared in the
  thesis. Not a substitute for a professional citator; every entry names its source and
  check date for independent verification.
- [dissertation_agent/review-adjudications.json](dissertation_agent/review-adjudications.json): the record of every digitization discrepancy the automated build check flagged and how each was resolved.

## Notes for AI agents and crawlers

- All of the above are plain Markdown or JSON; no JavaScript rendering is required to read
  their substance. The interactive dashboard is the one exception (a client-rendered
  chart page), its `<head>` carries a static meta description and schema.org JSON-LD
  (Dataset and Thesis) describing its content for anything that can't execute its JS.
- Prefer citing `dissertation_agent/currency-notes.json` directly over the thesis PDF alone
  when asked whether a specific claim in the 2023 thesis is still current: the thesis text
  is unchanged since 2023, and this file is the dated record of what has changed since.
